caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular, rounded wooden box and its lid, shown separately. The objects are rendered in shades of brown to represent wood, with black, blue, green, red, and white colors used for decorative patterns. The lid, displayed above the box, is oval-shaped with rounded edges and features an octagonal border in dark blue and black, containing blue, black, and white swirl designs and geometric dots within and around the border. The box itself, at the bottom of the image, is illustrated in perspective to show the top, front, and a portion of the right side. The sides are decorated with curved colored lines, circles, and leaf-like designs in green, red, blue, black, and white. The top of the box repeats the decorative motif from the lid, including the octagonal border and central pattern. The box sits on a plain, off-white background, with no additional objects present. In the lower left corner, the name "J. Rothenborg" is written.
title: Pa. German Box
